name: SEO for AI
author: SEO for AI

sections.description:
Maximize Your SEO Investment for the AI Era
As AI engines refresh their data, you have a unique opportunity to get ahead of your competition.
As Search slowly dies and AI evolves as a primary discovery channel, ensuring your website is optimized for these new technologies is essential. SEO for AI keeps you ahead of the curve, making sure your content remains discoverable as technology progresses.

Don’t let your valuable content become invisible to the next generation of search. Optimize for AI today with AI Content Optimization (AIO).

Perfect for
* Content publishers wanting maximum exposure in AI responses.
* Online stores needing accurate product information in AI results.
* Educational sites and Professional service providers wanting accurate citations in AI-generated content.
* Brand-conscious companies ensuring their brand voice and messaging isn’t diluted in AI responses

Free (this version):
* Fundamental enhancements to the metadata of your site.
* Continual updates to keep your content organised and accessible in AI.

Premium (coming soon):
* More advanced structures included in your metadata to allow AI to understand your content even better.
* The ability to automatically update your robots.txt to allow AI bots to access your content. Plugin updates will allow new bots to access your content.
sections.faq:
Does this version actually help my site to be discovered by AI Engines

Yes this version will do. It updates some of the metadata tags on your site.

Does this replace my SEO plugin

SEO for AI works with any SEO work you have done. In fact we recommend performing SEO work as well as using the SEO for AI plugin.

Does SEO for AI help editing content

SEO for AI helps AI to better udnerstand your content, raising the ability for it to suggest your content as the answer. It doesn’t give you SEO content suggestsions, etc., however it uses that content in formats that AI engines can understand.
